name: Akutsu Subaru
source:
He works at the same candy company as the protagonist.
He has a lot of confidence in himself, he's definitely not the cowardly type.
He's such a womanizer that there's a rumor that he has a girlfriend on every floor of the company.
But he thinks true love is a foolish thing.
He's very interested in the protagonist as the boss' girlfriend.
